intro_zh: 先听完整课文，再按中文巧合线记忆：乡村 fair 上，主人公进入 fortune-teller tent；Madam Bellinsky 用 crystal ball 说出 vague prediction；他一出 tent，wife 就催他去 station 接 sister。读的时候注意 future 预言句、真实安排句、The moment、As soon as 和 in less than an hour。

sentences.text: At a village fair, I decided to visit a fortune-teller called Madam Bellinsky.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：在乡村集市上，我决定去看一位叫 Madam Bellinsky 的 fortune-teller。注意 village fair 是旧式集市场景，fortune-teller 在这里是娱乐摊位。

sentences.text: After I had given her some money, she looked into a crystal ball and said: A relation of yours is coming to see you.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：我给钱之后，她看着 crystal ball，说我的一个亲戚要来看我。After I had given her some money 帮你读清先后顺序，a relation of yours 是故意模糊的说法。
focus_words: After I had given her some money

sentences.text: She will be arriving this evening and intends to stay for a few days.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：她今天傍晚会到，并打算住几天。Will be arriving 读出安排好的到达，intends to stay 是正式一点的“打算住下”。

sentences.text: The moment you leave this tent, you will get a big surprise.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：你一离开这个帐篷，就会大吃一惊。The moment 表示一……就……，这句要读出预言式的即时感。

sentences.text: A woman you know well will rush towards you.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：一位你很熟悉的女人会向你冲来。A woman you know well 听起来很个人化，但其实也很 vague；rush towards 要读出动作很快。

sentences.text: As soon as I went outside, I forgot all about Madam Bellinsky because my wife hurried towards me.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：我一走到外面，就忘了 Madam Bellinsky，因为妻子急匆匆向我走来。As soon as 和 The moment 呼应，后半句把神秘预言拉回普通生活。

sentences.text: Your sister will be here in less than an hour and we must be at the station to meet her. We are late already.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：你姐姐不到一小时就到，我们必须去车站接她，而且已经晚了。这里的 future 不是神秘预言，而是真实日程；in less than an hour 读出紧迫感。

sentences.text: As she walked away, I followed her out of the fair.
sentences.focus_zh: 中文锚点：她走开时，我跟着她出了集市。Followed her out of the fair 正好把 lead you away from this place 的普通解释收住。
